title: founder-content-writer batch spec (posts-spec.json)
description: What the model writes: one entry per post, with the angle, the hook type, the body per network, the source passages copied word for word and every claim the post makes. scripts/check_spec.py checks it against the raw material, positioning.proof, the network limits of content-publisher and the writing gate; scripts/build_batch.py turns a passing spec into posts.json. Validate the shape alone with: python3 shared/scripts/validate_json.py agents/founder-content-writer/assets/posts-spec.schema.json <posts-spec.json>

label.description: Batch label, also the folder name without its date.

language.description: The founder's language, the language of every post and of the summary.

summary.description: Two or three sentences for the founder, in their language: what this batch holds and what was left out. Goes through the writing gate.

sources_manifest.description: Path of the manifest written by scripts/ingest.py, relative to this file. Default: sources/manifest.json.

dropped.description: Material the raw notes hold and the batch does not use because no allowed source covers it: a number that is not in positioning.proof, a client name, a result. The founder decides whether to add it to project-context.

fix.description: What would make it usable, for example: add it to positioning.proof with its source.

limitations.description: What the model knows it could not check. Added to the Limitations the scripts detect.

ref.description: Stable id, same pattern as content-publisher: queue items become <ref>.<network>.

angle.description: The one idea of the post, in one sentence.

text.description: The body as published. No URL, no signature, no placeholder.

first_comment.description: Optional first comment. Must hold the link when the post has one. Default: link_note + link.

text.description: One tweet, 280 weighted characters at most. A thread only when config.x_allow_thread is true.

link.description: The one link of the post, or null. content-publisher places it in the first comment or first reply. It comes from the founder's material or from context.url.

link_note.description: Short line before the link in the comment or the reply.

source_passages.description: The passages this post comes from, copied word for word. Whitespace, curly or straight quote marks and Unicode composition may differ; nothing else may.

source_id.description: An id of the sources manifest.

quote_id.description: market-signal sources only: the verified quote the passage sits in.

claims.description: Every number, name, result or factual statement of the post that a reader could ask the source of. Empty when the post makes none. See assets/claims-model.md.

text.description: The claim as written in the post, word for word.

proof_index.description: source proof: the index in positioning.proof.

passage_index.description: source quote, url or passage: the index in source_passages.

reason.description: source none: why this number word is not a claim.
